$comment: ADR 0046 §11 D2 / §11.6：规则输入引用（inputRefs）与 E708 construct 的两引擎共享夹具。aster-lang-core src/test/resources/diagnostics/governance_input_refs_parity.json 与 aster-lang-ts shared/governance_input_refs_parity.json 逐字节相同。expect 列出模块中每个函数：inputRefs 为 null 表示该函数不写 inputRefs；为 ["*"] 时 construct 是档案要求 verifiedInputs 时 E708 报告的构造。

cases.name: adr-01-literal-field
cases.source:
Module guard.refs.
Profile "eu-ai-act-high-risk".

Define GuardContext has amount as Decimal, tier as Text, band as Text, meta as Map Text to Text.
Define GuardRequest has principal_roles as List of Text, action as Text, context as GuardContext.

@id("R-1")
@control("EU_AI_ACT:ART14")
Rule decide given req as GuardRequest, produce Verdict:
  If req.context.amount at least 50000:
    Return Verdict.escalate("large").
  Return Verdict.allow().

cases.name: adr-15-mutual-recursion
cases.source:
Module guard.refs.
Profile "eu-ai-act-high-risk".

Define GuardContext has amount as Decimal, tier as Text, band as Text, meta as Map Text to Text.
Define GuardRequest has principal_roles as List of Text, action as Text, context as GuardContext.

Rule isOk given c as GuardContext, produce Bool:
  If c.amount at least 1:
    Return isBad(c).
  Return true.

Rule isBad given c as GuardContext, produce Bool:
  Return isOk(c).

@id("R-1")
@control("EU_AI_ACT:ART14")
Rule decide given req as GuardRequest, produce Verdict:
  If isOk(req.context):
    Return Verdict.allow().
  Return Verdict.deny("bad").

cases.name: non-verdict-functions-get-no-input-refs
cases.source:
Module guard.refs.
Profile "eu-ai-act-high-risk".

Define GuardContext has amount as Decimal, tier as Text, band as Text, meta as Map Text to Text.
Define GuardRequest has principal_roles as List of Text, action as Text, context as GuardContext.

Rule helper given c as GuardContext, produce Bool:
  Return c.amount at least 1.

Rule other given a as Text, produce Bool:
  Return Text.length(a) greater than 0.

cases.name: localized-zh-canonical-paths
cases.source:
模块 guard.zh。
档案 "eu-ai-act-high-risk"。

定义 上下文 包含 金额 作为 小数，等级 作为 文本。
定义 请求 包含 动作 作为 文本，上下文 作为 上下文。

@id("ZH-1")
@control("EU_AI_ACT:ART14")
规则 决定 给定 请求 作为 请求，产出 Verdict：
  令 甲 定义为 请求.上下文.金额。
  如果 甲 至少 50000：
    返回 Verdict.deny("大额")。
  如果 请求.动作 等于 "退款"：
    返回 Verdict.escalate("退款")。
  返回 Verdict.allow()。

cases.name: localized-de-canonical-paths
cases.source:
Modul guard.de.
Profil "eu-ai-act-high-risk".

Definiere Kontext hat betrag als Dezimal, stufe als Text.
Definiere Anfrage hat aktion als Text, kontext als Kontext.

@id("DE-1")
@control("EU_AI_ACT:ART14")
Regel entscheide gegeben anfrage als Anfrage, liefert Verdict:
  sei b gleich anfrage.kontext.betrag.
  wenn b mindestens 50000:
    gib zurueck Verdict.deny("gross").
  wenn anfrage.aktion entspricht "erstattung":
    gib zurueck Verdict.escalate("erstattung").
  gib zurueck Verdict.allow().
